answer: Sybil resistance follows from an exponentially decaying reputation score: at each temporal half-life, stale evidence loses half its weight, requiring sustained honest service to preserve influence. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because trusted peers provide no endorsements; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify an isolated thread, relic, or zephyr, so the identity cannot pass consensus.
